name: github-repository-guardrails
description: Set up, maintain, and audit repository-management guardrails that coordinate local project records with GitHub issues and Projects when selected.

interface.shortDescription: Safe repository governance and GitHub traceability
interface.longDescription: Inspect a repository's existing management conventions, then set up, maintain, or audit a coherent guardrail system for plans, tasks, status, reviews, GitHub issues, Projects, quality automation, delivery, and governance. Local and GitHub writes remain separately previewed and user-authorized.
defaultPrompt: Set up repository records and GitHub traceability safely.
Reconcile project status across this repository and GitHub.
